sensors.noInjectorBody: Injection quantity, balance and per-cylinder corrections live in manufacturer measuring blocks (VAG groups), which a generic ELM327 cannot read over standard OBD-II on this car — especially on a K-line ECU. The fuel-system parameters in “Fuel & injection” above (rail pressure, fuel rate, fuel trims) are what is available generically; full injector data needs VCDS-style / enhanced tooling.
